The force display window is restricted to $\pm10$~eV·\AA$^{-1}$, omitting 106 outlying Scratch-MultiT test components that remain fully accounted for in all reported numerical metrics. Plotted energy correlations serve as relative within-cluster diagnostics, whereas tabulated uncentred, seed-resolved errors (\sitab{tab:current_pointwise}) preserve absolute energy and force offsets.

Color hue distinguishes model strategies, open versus filled symbols designate 600~K versus MultiT training regimes, and marker shapes identify training seeds (foundation variations reflect independent checkpoints). Simulations are initialized from a common configuration at 200~ps with a target duration of 1~ns (1~fs timestep, 200-step output interval). Trajectory curves terminate at their respective observed simulation horizons, and structural summaries integrate all available, unequal time windows. Only three foundation checkpoints and FT-600K seed 234 successfully sustain the full 1~ns target (\sitab{tab:md_horizons}), indicating that trajectory survival represents a stringent test of model lineage that uncouples from static pointwise accuracy.
